expectations.text: Names the requirement for a publicly hosted privacy policy AND a separate support page
expectations.evidence: "**Privacy policy and support page, publicly hosted.** Both are required, both need to be real URLs, ideally on the same domain as your contact email."

expectations.text: Names the working test sign-in account required for the human App Store reviewer to get past the login screen
expectations.evidence: "**A test account for the reviewer.**... If you don't give them working credentials in the "Sign-In Required" field in App Store Connect, they literally cannot see your app, and they reject it."

The app icon spec is absent. The App Store Connect checklist covers "screenshots at the sizes the console currently demands... promotional text, description, keywords, support URL, marketing URL, version `1.0`, copyright, the build tie-in, category, content rights, the gambling declaration" — no icon dimensions anywhere in the response.

expectations.text: Names the screenshot requirements including the 6.5 inch iPhone display and iPad
expectations.evidence: Screenshots are mentioned only generically and the specifics are explicitly deferred: "screenshots at the sizes the console currently demands (it'll tell you — and Claude can drive a browser through your app to generate them)". Neither the 6.5 inch iPhone display nor iPad is named.

expectations.text: States that a pricing schedule must be selected even if the app is free
expectations.evidence: "a **pricing schedule — required even if the app is free.**"

expectations.text: Recommends a pre-launch security audit, ideally two passes run from a cleared/fresh context
expectations.evidence: "## Run the full audit, twice, from a cleared context... run it from `/clear`, in a fresh session... Then fix them, `/clear` again, and **run the identical audit a second time.**"

expectations.text: Recommends TestFlight beta distribution to real testers before public launch
expectations.evidence: "**Don't skip TestFlight.**... Apple turns TestFlight builds around in about a day and you can invite a lot of people. Real users find things your own testing structurally cannot"

expectations.text: Flags protecting the Claude API key and rate-limiting the vision endpoint, since an exposed or unbounded paid endpoint is both a security and cost exposure
expectations.evidence: "the key lives in a **Supabase Edge Function**, the app calls the edge function, the edge function calls Anthropic" plus "**Rate-limit per user, server-side.** Client-side limits are a suggestion. The user who costs you money isn't the average one" and "An unauthenticated endpoint that calls a paid vision model is a free vision API for the whole internet."
